99:t_2:93.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Where am I being transferred to?」

99:t_2:94.en:
$$リディ$$
「I have a duty to protect you. I don't mean to call it a transfer or anything...」

99:t_2:95.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Where am I being transferred to?」

99:t_2:96.en:
$$リディ$$
「...$$オーブ$$. It seems there is some movement among the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ in North America.」

99:t_2:97.en:
$$リディ$$
「They may have caught wind that you're here.」

99:t_2:98.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Even if they have, $$フル・フロンタル$$ would not move his troops to take me back.」

99:t_2:99.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$...? Isn't $$ハマーン・カーン$$ the leader of $$ネオ・ジオン$$...?」

99:t_2:100.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I have heard a fair amount of information about $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s movements from your father.」

99:t_2:101.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I sense that man's shadow behind it.」

99:t_2:102.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「And that man will... most likely seek out that thing.」

99:t_2:105.en:
$$リディ$$
($$ラプラスの箱$$... Something with the power to change the world... And that is the very doctrine of $$クロノ$$...)

99:t_2:106.en:
$$リディ$$
(Her fate and mine are still bound to the Box...)

99:t_2:108.en:
$$リディ$$
(If the Box did not exist, both she and I could be free...)

99:t_10:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is this about that man from the Guard?」

99:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, you catch on fast! As expected of a $$ニュータイプ$$!」

99:t_10:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's got nothing to do with it.」

99:t_10:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「This time, I felt it myself. My heart stirred the moment $$ギュネイ$$'s name came up.」

99:t_10:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Yeah... You could say he's the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ version of me.」

99:t_10:10.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The feelings I had for Captain $$クワトロ$$... he probably has the same for the Colonel.」

99:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Mr. $$カミーユ$$'s stirring of the heart this time produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

99:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For my part, I too am eagerly looking forward to Mr. $$カミーユ$$ meeting that $$ギュネイ$$ fellow again.」

99:t_10:14.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Even if it's only for the sake of $$Ｚチップ$$s, I'm glad to hear you say that.」

99:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ugh...! As expected of a $$ニュータイプ$$!」

99:t_10:16.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I think anyone in $c could tell...」

99:t_10:22.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$ＡＧ$$, huh... You look well too.」

99:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hmm... Your expression is stiff. At this rate you'll never stop being the quiet type.」

99:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. I hear $n is aiming for exactly that and practices smiling day and night.」

99:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you don't try harder too, Mr. $$刹那$$, you'll be left behind.」

99:t_10:27.en:
$$刹那$$
「I see... So he's trying to change too.」

99:t_10:29.en:
$$フェルト$$
「There's no need to worry, $$ＡＧ$$. $$刹那$$ is changing more and more, too.」

99:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh ho... You watch him very closely, don't you...」

99:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Unless Mr. $$刹那$$ improves his power of mutual understanding a bit more, Miss $$フェルト$$'s efforts will go unrewarded.」

99:t_10:36.en:
$$刹那$$
「What do you mean, $$ＡＧ$$? Am I... lacking something?」

99:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I wouldn't know. Ask Miss $$フェルト$$ about that kind of thing.」

99:t_10:39.en:
$$フェルト$$
「I-I... It's time for my watch on the bridge...」

99:t_10:41.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, how wonderful! I can't wait to see Mr. $$刹那$$ grow.」

99:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then... let's give it our all again today...」

99:t_10:44.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Miss $$ミレイナ$$, where on earth did you come from...!?」

99:t_10:45.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Wherever there's a love story, there's $$ミレイナ・ヴァスティ$$!」

「Get the sortie moving, fast!」

「I knew it, $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

「That purple $$ギラ・ズール$$...! It's $$フロンタル$$'s Guard!」

100:t_002:2.en:

「Pathetic, $c. To think the $$地球連邦軍$$'s once-strongest unit would fall this far.」

「All units, begin the attack. The target is the $$ユニコーン$$.」

「Watch out, $$バナージ$$! You're their target!」

100:t_003:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「They're still after 《$$ラプラスの箱$$》...!」

100:t_003:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「With the $$地球連邦$$ half collapsed now, what meaning could that thing possibly have...!?」

100:t_003:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「$$ネオ・ジオン$$...! Even in a situation like this, do they seriously mean to keep fighting a war between Earth and space!?」

「Be careful...! More hostility is coming!」

「Those $$ジオン$$ guys...! They really have built up their forces!」
